findings.title: Stats error state has no retry; recovering requires changing dates or reloading
findings.steps: Open /stats while the API is down or returns 5xx (or a request fails). Bring the API back.
findings.expected: Error message with a Retry button that refetches /api/stats/harvests without a reload.
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage with the error text is shown; no retry control. The `refresh` function from useApiFetch isn't destructured or used anywhere on the page.
findings.evidence: stats.vue destructures only { data, error, status } and renders <AlertMessage v-if="statsError"> with no button.

findings.title: Clearing a date field silently uses the default and can produce a confusing 'From must be on or before To' error
findings.steps: On /stats set To = 2025-06-01, then clear the From field (or set From = 2027-02-01 and clear To).
findings.expected: A blank field gets a visible reason (e.g. 'Enter a From date'), or means an open range; the request doesn't fail over a date the user never entered.
findings.actual: The blank param is left out, the backend swaps in the current year's 1 Jan / 31 Dec, and the page shows 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' while From looks empty. If no error comes back, the table covers a range other than the one shown in the inputs.
findings.evidence: curl /api/stats/harvests?to=2025-06-01 -> {"detail":"The From date must be on or before the To date."}; ?from=2027-02-01 -> same. In stats.vue the query computed drops empty values.

findings.title: Stats request has no timeout; 'Loading stats…' can stay forever
findings.steps: Open /stats while the API accepts connections but doesn't answer (hung server).
findings.expected: Request fails after 10 s and shows the error state with retry.
findings.actual: useApiFetch / $fetch.create set no timeout, so the request and the 'Loading stats…' text can stay up indefinitely.
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts has no timeout option; stats.vue passes none.

findings.title: Monthly table leaves out months with no harvests
findings.steps: Open /stats with the default range (current year).
findings.expected: Weight per month for the chosen range, with months that have no harvests shown as – or 0.
findings.actual: Only months that have harvests become columns (Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep 2026), so gaps in the range are hidden and columns from different ranges don't line up.
